en: Black-and-white image of a quiet residential street lined with two large, late‑19th/early‑20th‑century bourgeois villas featuring stucco façades, gabled roofs with chimneys, and classical decorative details around the windows and entrance. The houses are fronted by mature trees, hedges, and a white picket fence with gates and a small gatehouse. A wide unpaved road with a sidewalk and streetlamps runs along the front. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.
